title: Qwen3.8-Max goes public, weights promised next week - TCR 08/03/26
description:
Alibaba opened its 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8-Max through QwenWork and promised downloadable weights within a week; Anthropic engineer Levent Alpoge said Fable produced proposed solutions to five of the ten math problems OpenAI attributed to its unreleased Astra model and said it did so in 24 hours; and China approved eight 1,127-megawatt Hualong One reactors totaling more than nine gigawatts across four provinces.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-3-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:38 Alibaba opens Qwen3.8-Max, weights next week
5:14 AI server demand reaches the circuit-board layer
7:59 China approves eight fleet-scale reactors
10:32 Electrochemical loops turn waste into feedstock
13:10 A neurotoxin reprogrammed into a cancer-cell switch
16:01 Close

This episode covers Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max open access and one-week weights promise, Thinking Machines' staged-release safety framework, the AI-driven printed-circuit-board shortage pushing prices up more than 20%, China's eight-reactor fleet-scale nuclear approval, two electrochemical cells turning nitrate waste into ammonia and formamide, a botulinum-derived cancer-cell switch, and a trace-polymer cement that heals its own cracks.

Monday's spine is how quickly capability moves once it exists, and how far into the physical world its demands now reach. Alibaba compressed the distance from controlled use to full ownership into days, while an Anthropic engineer reported that its system produced proposed solutions to five of a competitor's ten problems within 24 hours, suggesting leading labs may struggle to turn a temporary lead into a lasting advantage. Thinking Machines argued for staging some capability to vetted defenders first, a serious case sharpened by a Reuters finding that PLA-linked researchers trained defense systems on outputs from US models. Beneath the model layer, AI servers are absorbing circuit-board capacity and competing with grid and electric-vehicle equipment, while China approved eight repeatable reactors to build the firm power that buildout needs. And the science kept compressing timelines its own way: waste becoming feedstock, a neurotoxin becoming a cancer-cell switch, and cement learning to close its own fractures in hours.
